title: Custom Slide Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place Opentrons 20 µL tip rack in slot 1, Opentrons Tube Rack with 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes in slot 2, and the custom adaptor that holds four PTFE‑printed slides (each with 21 spots) in the appropriate slot as shown in the deck map.

steps.title: Load labware definitions
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, then upload the custom labware definition for the slide adaptor (if this is the first run) into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the completed protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate the tip rack, tube rack, slide adaptor, and the P20 single‑channel pipette. Follow the app’s prompts and any referenced support articles for tip‑calibration.

steps.title: Spot slides with 1 µL transfers
steps.instruction: Perform the following transfers with the P20 pipette, discarding the tip after each individual transfer unless otherwise noted:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of solution from tube A2 (1.5 mL Eppendorf) to every one of the 21 spots on each of the four slides; change tip before moving to the next solution.
Repeat the above for solutions in tubes A3, A4, and A5, changing tip between each solution.
Add 1 µL of solution to each spot in triplicate by cycling through tube A6 in slot 2 and tubes A1‑A6 in slot 3; discard tip after each transfer.
Repeat the triplicate transfer sequence for rows B, C, and D (corresponding to slides 2, 3, and 4).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App, press “Run” to execute the programmed transfers.
